answers.core: This greatly accelerates the development of things, that in some games could be loaded procedurally. I do realize, that the inability to load up the folders could be due to a fact that people would use this as a way-to-go importing mechanism, instead of using proper .zip/.pck importers, but it should just be mentioned in docs that this is only for WIP purposes and nothing else.

title: Allow to load a folder into filesystem in runtime, like it is already possible with .zip/.pck
